scripts.copy-libs: mkdir -p www/lib/tess-core www/lib/tess-lang && cp node_modules/@zxing/library/umd/index.min.js www/zxing.min.js && cp node_modules/@tensorflow/tfjs/dist/tf.min.js node_modules/@tensorflow-models/mobilenet/dist/mobilenet.min.js node_modules/tesseract.js/dist/tesseract.min.js node_modules/tesseract.js/dist/worker.min.js www/lib/ && cp node_modules/tesseract.js-core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js www/lib/tess-core/ && gunzip -c node_modules/@tesseract.js-data/fra/4.0.0_best_int/fra.traineddata.gz > www/lib/tess-lang/fra.traineddata
